title: Campus Factor for Observation and Emergency Close-Outs — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Finance schedule.** The campus factor multiplies the whole close-out value of an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) closed on an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Campus | Factor |
|---|---|
| Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah | 0.95 |
| Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton | 1.04 |
| otherwise (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton) | 1 |

Example (hypothetical): a close-out value of 2,000.00 becomes 1,900.00 at Neenah and 2,080.00 at Chilton.
